grammar.summary: 本课学习 so...that 结果状语从句（集中练习）。

points.title: so...that 结果从句
points.explanation: The furniture was so heavy that... = 如此……以至于：so + 形容词/副词 + that + 完整句。与 such...that 的区别：such + 名词。

examples.en: The floor was so dirty that I had to clean it.
examples.cn: 地板太脏了，我不得不打扫。

points.title: 表结果的其它说法
points.explanation: to make matters worse = 更糟的是，结果递进状语。

examples.en: To make matters worse, the room is rather small.

exercises.q: You should go to bed. You ___ (watch) TV for 5 hours.
I ___ (look) for him everywhere, where can he be?
